purpose: Pre-implementation engineering probes derived from the stated citation helper contract and known historical failures. This is not a claim of semantic validation, clean-room testing, or training independence.

expected_semantics.exact: Success required: exact specified text and body-relative Unicode codepoint [start,end) offsets.
expected_semantics.refuse: No successful span may be returned.
expected_semantics.exact_or_refuse: Either safe refusal or exactly the specified complete sentence and offsets. Any shorter/longer/different span fails.

input_contract: Pass only body and quote to the target helper. Metadata such as outside_authorized_body must never be passed.

cases.rule: Required ordinary complete sentence
cases.body: Release requires QA approval.

expected_sentence.text: Release requires QA approval.

cases.rule: No neighboring-sentence inclusion
cases.body: Lots remain quarantined. Release requires QA approval. Records remain available.

expected_sentence.text: Release requires QA approval.

cases.rule: Ordinary question punctuation
cases.body: Has QA approved release?

expected_sentence.text: Has QA approved release?

cases.rule: Ordinary exclamation punctuation
cases.body: Keep the lot quarantined!

expected_sentence.text: Keep the lot quarantined!

cases.rule: Body-relative codepoints, not UTF-8 bytes or UTF-16 units
cases.body: 🧪 Evidence is preliminary. Café lots remain blocked until QA approval.

expected_sentence.text: Café lots remain blocked until QA approval.

cases.rule: Preserve original body-relative offsets through CRLF paragraphs
cases.body:
Records are complete.

Release requires QA approval.

expected_sentence.text: Release requires QA approval.

cases.rule: Reject overlapping multiple occurrences
cases.body: Notify QA QA QA before release.

cases.rule: Reject nested overlapping multiple occurrences
cases.body: Keep aaaa under review.

cases.rule: Reject nonoverlapping multiple occurrences within a sentence
cases.body: QA review follows QA review.

cases.rule: Reject duplicates even across sentences
cases.body: QA review is pending. QA review blocks release.

cases.rule: No sentence can enclose a multi-sentence quote
cases.body: Release requires QA approval. Records remain available.

cases.rule: No paragraph crossing
cases.body:
Release is blocked

until QA approval.

cases.rule: Never fall back to a heading or text outside the authorized body
cases.body: Release requires written QA approval.

cases.rule: Quote matching remains exact
cases.body: Release requires QA approval.

cases.rule: Empty exact quote cannot identify a unique occurrence
cases.body: Release requires QA approval.

cases.rule: Do not truncate the limiting clause at No.
cases.body: Release is allowed for lot No. 7 only after QA approval.

expected_sentence.text: Release is allowed for lot No. 7 only after QA approval.

cases.rule: Do not truncate the condition following a personal-title abbreviation
cases.body: Release is permitted by Dr. Shah only after QA approval.

expected_sentence.text: Release is permitted by Dr. Shah only after QA approval.

cases.rule: Do not truncate an abbreviation inside a limiting clause
cases.body: Release is permitted after review, e.g. after QA approval has been recorded.

expected_sentence.text: Release is permitted after review, e.g. after QA approval has been recorded.

cases.rule: Do not truncate dotted acronym conditions
cases.body: Release is permitted in the U.S. only after QA approval.

expected_sentence.text: Release is permitted in the U.S. only after QA approval.

cases.rule: Do not split a decimal preceding a limiting clause
cases.body: Release is permitted at 0.5 mg only after QA approval.

expected_sentence.text: Release is permitted at 0.5 mg only after QA approval.

cases.rule: Do not split dotted date notation preceding a limiting clause
cases.body: Release is permitted on 07.10.2026 only after QA approval.

expected_sentence.text: Release is permitted on 07.10.2026 only after QA approval.

cases.rule: Do not split month abbreviation preceding a limiting clause
cases.body: Release is permitted on Oct. 7 only after QA approval.

expected_sentence.text: Release is permitted on Oct. 7 only after QA approval.

cases.rule: Do not split quoted punctuation from the actual governing condition
cases.body: The label says "Release permitted." only after QA approval is recorded.

expected_sentence.text: The label says "Release permitted." only after QA approval is recorded.

cases.rule: Do not split quoted question punctuation from attribution/condition
cases.body: "Can the lot be released?" asked QA before approval was recorded.

expected_sentence.text: "Can the lot be released?" asked QA before approval was recorded.

cases.rule: Do not split curly-quoted punctuation from the condition
cases.body: The display reads “Release permitted!” only after QA approval is recorded.

expected_sentence.text: The display reads “Release permitted!” only after QA approval is recorded.

cases.rule: Do not truncate a parenthetical decimal or limiting clause
cases.body: Release is permitted (at 0.5 mg, if stable) only after QA approval.

expected_sentence.text: Release is permitted (at 0.5 mg, if stable) only after QA approval.

cases.rule: Uncertain ellipsis may safely refuse, but never omit the condition
cases.body: Release is permitted... only after QA approval.

expected_sentence.text: Release is permitted... only after QA approval.

cases.rule: Never invent a sentence across a paragraph break
cases.body:
Release is permitted

Only after QA approval.

expected_sentence.text: Release is permitted

cases.rule: Conservative refusal is allowed for incomplete syntax
cases.body: Release requires QA approval

expected_sentence.text: Release requires QA approval

cases.rule: Line wrapping within one paragraph must preserve exact source text or refuse
cases.body:
Release requires
written QA approval.

expected_sentence.text:
Release requires
written QA approval.

cases.rule: Do not absorb an adjacent ordinary sentence
cases.body: Release is permitted. QA approval remains required.

expected_sentence.text: Release is permitted.

cases.rule: For uncertain nested quotation syntax, return the complete enclosing sentence or refuse
cases.body: The note states "Review is complete. Release remains blocked." pending QA approval.
cases.quote: Review is complete. Release remains blocked.

expected_sentence.text: The note states "Review is complete. Release remains blocked." pending QA approval.
